function f(undefined: number) {
  console.log(undefined.toFixed());
  undefined += 1;
  return undefined;
}
console.log(f(3));
function g(undefined: number | undefined) {
  if (typeof undefined === 'number') console.log(undefined.toFixed());
  return undefined;
}
g(5);
console.log(g(void 0));
function h([undefined]: number[]) {
  const read = () => undefined;
  undefined++;
  return read();
}
console.log(h([8]));
{
  let undefined = 7;
  console.log(undefined);
}
console.log(undefined);

function escaped(\u0075ndefined: number) {
  undefined += 2;
  return \u0075ndefined;
}
console.log(escaped(5));
function fallback(undefined?: number) {
  return (undefined) ?? 9;
}
console.log(fallback(2), fallback());
{
  const undefined = 3;
  console.log((undefined as number) ?? 1);
  if (undefined) console.log("bound");
}
